RedMagic 12 Pro+ Resmi Diluncurkan: Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, Layar 185Hz, Baterai 8.400mAh

Red Magic has officially launched the RedMagic 12 Pro+ gaming phone with REDMAGIC OS 12 . Powered by Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 , the phone features a 6.85-inch BOE X11 , 1.5K , 185Hz , LTPO OLED hole less full screen display. RedMagic 12 Pro+ integrates top-tier performance with advanced cooling tech, dedicated gaming features, and a massive 8,400mAh battery . RedMagic 12 Pro+ with 12GB RAM and 256GB of storage starts at ¥ 6,999. The 16GB/512GB variant costs ¥7,999. The top model with 16GB RAM + 1TB of storage is priced at ¥ 8,999 yuan. RedMagic 12 Pro+ comes with a 6.85-inch BOE X11 1.5K LTPO display, offering an uninterrupted viewing experience through an under-display camera (UDC) for a true Hole Less full screen. The screen reaches up to 5000 nits peak brightness and 1900 nits HBM (High Brightness Mode) , with 185Hz refresh rate . RedMagic 12 Pro+ is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen6, built on a cutting-edge 2nm process . It is paired with the RedCore R5 Gaming Chip designed for gaming and haptic feedback. The phone’s memory speeds are off the charts, integrating LPDDR5T RAM , with 10667Mbps and ultra-fast UFS 4.1 Pro storage . RedMagic 12 Pro+ combines a comprehensive thermal management system to keep the phone cool down. It uses a 13116mm² 4D Ice level Vapor Chamber cooling system , a built-in high-speed centrifugal fan spinning at 25,500 RPM , and customizable RGB lighting effects . RedMagic 12 Pro+ allows gamers to play uninterruptedly with a colossal 8400mAh dual-cell battery . The gaming phone supports 120W wired charging and 80W wireless charging . It also includes Bypass Charging , allowing users to power the motherboard directly while gaming to reduce heat and protect battery longevity. The phone uses REDMAGIC OS 12 and offers hardcore gaming features , including a built-in PC emulator and Steam Direct Connection .
